Fails if the user moves last this turn.
silktrap.shortDesc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: -1 Spe.

silverwind.name: Silver Wind
silverwind.desc: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
silverwind.shortDesc: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).

simplebeam.name: Simple Beam
simplebeam.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become Simple. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Simple, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

sing.name: Sing
sing.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.
sing.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

sizzlyslide.name: Sizzly Slide
sizzlyslide.desc: Has a 100% chance to burn the foe.

sketch.name: Sketch
sketch.desc: This move is permanently replaced by the last move used by the target. The copied move has the maximum PP for that move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user has Transformed, or if the move is Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Dark Void, Hyperspace Fury, Magical Torque, Noxious Torque, Revival Blessing, Sketch, Struggle, Tera Starstorm, Wicked Torque, or any move the user knows.
sketch.shortDesc: Permanently copies the last move target used.

skillswap.name: Skill Swap
skillswap.desc: The user swaps its Ability with the target's Ability. Fails if either the user or the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
skillswap.shortDesc: The user and the target trade Abilities.

skittersmack.name: Skitter Smack
skittersmack.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
skittersmack.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower target's Sp. Atk by 1.

skullbash.name: Skull Bash
skullbash.desc: Charges with +2 priority, raising the user's Attack, Defense, and Special Defense by 1 stage each. While charging, the user takes 20% less damage from attacks. Attacks at normal priority on the next turn. After dealing damage, restores 10% of the user's base maximum HP. Skipping the charge, such as with Power Herb, keeps the stat boosts but does not grant charge-turn priority or the charging damage reduction.
skullbash.shortDesc: +2 charge: +1 Atk/Def/SpD, 20% less damage. Hit heals 10%.

skyattack.name: Sky Attack
skyattack.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch and a higher chance for a critical hit. Its charge turn has +4 priority, raises the user's Speed by 1 stage, and prevents its Speed from being lowered. The attack lands at normal priority on the next turn, ignoring the target's evasion boosts, Reflect, and Aurora Veil. During Tailwind or Strong Winds, it attacks immediately at 90 power with an even higher critical-hit ratio. Power Herb and other charge-skipping effects make it attack immediately at 140 power with that higher critical-hit ratio.
skyattack.shortDesc: +4 priority charge: +1 Spe; next turn 140 BP. Tailwind/Strong Winds: instant 90 BP.

skydrop.name: Sky Drop
skydrop.desc: This attack takes the target into the air with the user on the first turn and executes on the second. Pokemon weighing 200 kg or more cannot be lifted. On the first turn, the user and the target avoid all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister. The user and the target cannot make a move between turns, but the target can select a move to use. This move cannot damage Flying-type Pokemon. Fails on the first turn if the target is an ally, if the target has a substitute, or if the target is using Bounce, Dig, Dive, Fly, Phantom Force, Shadow Force, or Sky Drop.
skydrop.shortDesc: User and foe fly up turn 1. Damages on turn 2.

skyuppercut.name: Sky Uppercut
skyuppercut.desc: This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop.
skyuppercut.shortDesc: Can hit Pokemon using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop.

slackoff.name: Slack Off
slackoff.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
slackoff.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

slash.name: Slash
slash.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

sleeppowder.name: Sleep Powder
sleeppowder.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.
sleeppowder.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

sleeptalk.name: Sleep Talk
sleeptalk.desc: One of the user's known moves, besides this move, is selected for use at random. Fails if the user is not asleep. The selected move does not have PP deducted from it, and can currently have 0 PP. This move cannot select Assist, Beak Blast, Belch, Bide, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Focus Punch, Hold Hands, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Uproar, Wicked Torque, or any two-turn move.
sleeptalk.shortDesc: User must be asleep. Uses another known move.

sludge.name: Sludge
sludge.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

sludgebomb.name: Sludge Bomb
sludgebomb.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

sludgewave.name: Sludge Wave
sludgewave.desc: Has a 10% chance to poison the target.

smackdown.name: Smack Down
smackdown.desc: This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. During the effect, Magnet Rise fails for the target and Telekinesis fails against the target.

smartstrike.name: Smart Strike
smartstrike.desc: This move does not check accuracy.
smartstrike.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

smellingsalts.name: Smelling Salts
smellingsalts.desc: Power doubles if the target is paralyzed. If the user has not fainted, the target is cured of paralysis.
smellingsalts.shortDesc: Power doubles if target is paralyzed, and cures it.

smog.name: Smog
smog.desc: Has a 40% chance to poison the target.

smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
smokescreen.desc: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

snaptrap.name: Snap Trap
snaptrap.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
snaptrap.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

snarl.name: Snarl
snarl.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
snarl.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Sp. Atk by 1.

snatch.name: Snatch
snatch.desc: If another Pokemon uses certain non-damaging moves this turn, the user steals that move to use itself. If multiple Pokemon use one of those moves this turn, the applicable moves are all stolen by the first Pokemon in turn order that used this move this turn. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.
snatch.shortDesc: User steals certain support moves to use itself.

snipeshot.name: Snipe Shot
snipeshot.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. This move cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect. This move uses Attack instead of Special Attack if the user's Attack is higher than its Special Attack.
snipeshot.shortDesc: High crit; cannot be redirected; uses higher offense.

snore.name: Snore
snore.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the user is not asleep.
snore.shortDesc: User must be asleep. 30% chance to flinch target.

snowscape.name: Snowscape
snowscape.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. During the effect, the Defense of Ice-type Pokemon is multiplied by 1.5 when taking damage from a physical attack. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Snow.
snowscape.shortDesc: For 5 turns, snow falls. Ice: 1.5x Def.

soak.name: Soak
soak.desc: Causes the target to become a Water type. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Water type, or if the target is Terastallized.
soak.shortDesc: Changes the target's type to Water.

softboiled.name: Soft-Boiled
softboiled.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
softboiled.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

solarbeam.name: Solar Beam
solarbeam.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move still requires a turn to charge.
solarbeam.shortDesc: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.

solarblade.name: Solar Blade
solarblade.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Hail, Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move still requires a turn to charge.
solarblade.shortDesc: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.

sonicboom.name: Sonic Boom
sonicboom.desc: Deals 20 HP of damage to the target.

spacialrend.name: Spacial Rend
spacialrend.desc: Uses the user's higher offensive stat and has a high critical-hit ratio. When used by Palkia, this move never misses, ignores protection, and cannot be redirected.
spacialrend.shortDesc: Uses higher offense; high crit. Palkia: never misses; ignores Protect/redirection.

spark.name: Spark
spark.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

sparklingaria.name: Sparkling Aria
sparklingaria.desc: If the user has not fainted, the target is cured of its burn.
sparklingaria.shortDesc: The target is cured of its burn.

sparklyswirl.name: Sparkly Swirl
sparklyswirl.desc: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition.
sparklyswirl.shortDesc: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.

spectralthief.name: Spectral Thief
spectralthief.desc: The target's stat stages greater than 0 are stolen from it and applied to the user before dealing damage.
spectralthief.shortDesc: Steals target's boosts before dealing damage.

speedswap.name: Speed Swap
speedswap.desc: The user swaps its Speed stat with the target. Stat stage changes are unaffected.

spicyextract.name: Spicy Extract
spicyextract.desc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and lowers its Defense by 2 stages.
spicyextract.shortDesc: Raises target's Atk by 2 and lowers its Def by 2.

spiderweb.name: Spider Web
spiderweb.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
spiderweb.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.

spikecannon.name: Spike Cannon
spikecannon.desc: A 25 Base Power Water-type attack that hits two to five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it takes damage from the remaining hits. Skill Link makes this move hit five times.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to three times before failing. Opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
spikes.shortDesc: Hurts grounded foes on switch-in. Max 3 layers.

spikyshield.name: Spiky Shield
spikyshield.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
spikyshield.shortDesc: Protects from moves. Contact: loses 1/8 max HP.

spinout.name: Spin Out
spinout.desc: Lowers the user's Speed by 2 stages.

spiritbreak.name: Spirit Break
spiritbreak.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
spiritbreak.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

spiritshackle.name: Spirit Shackle
spiritshackle.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit and prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
spiritshackle.shortDesc: High critical-hit ratio; prevents the target from switching.

spite.name: Spite
spite.desc: Causes the target's last move used to lose 4 PP. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if it no longer knows the move.
spite.shortDesc: Lowers the PP of the target's last move by 4.

spitup.name: Spit Up
spitup.desc: Power is equal to 100 times the user's Stockpile count. At 3 Stockpile counts, this move hits through protection for half damage, unless it was used automatically by Accumulation. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. Normally, this move consumes all Stockpile stacks and removes their Defense and Special Defense boosts. If used by a Pokemon with Accumulation, it is followed by Belch on the same target and consumes only 1 Stockpile stack.
spitup.shortDesc: More power with Stockpile; Accumulation consumes only 1 stack.

splishysplash.name: Splishy Splash
splishysplash.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

spookyspell.name: Spooky Spell
spookyspell.desc: Applies Curse to the damaged target if it is not already cursed.

spore.name: Spore
spore.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.
spore.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

spotlight.name: Spotlight
spotlight.desc: Until the end of the turn, single-target attacks aimed at the user are redirected to the target. In Free-for-All battles, this move ignores Protect. It cannot make the target hit itself, and it does not redirect Hydra Bond or multi-hit follow-up attacks that chain to another target. Fails outside Double Battle or Free-for-All formats.
spotlight.shortDesc: Attacks aimed at user redirect to target. FFA: ignores Protect.

springtidestorm.name: Springtide Storm
springtidestorm.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage. This move does not check accuracy in Misty Terrain.
springtidestorm.shortDesc: 30% chance to lower foe(s) Attack by 1. Misty Terrain: can't miss.

stabbyswarm.name: Stabby Swarm
stabbyswarm.desc: Traps opposing Pokemon for 4-5 turns and damages them each turn. In Forest Field, power is 1.5x and Defense falls by 1. Grip Claw extends the trap to 7 turns.
stabbyswarm.shortDesc: Traps foes; 1.5x and -1 Def in Forest; Grip Claw extends it.

stealthrock.name: Stealth Rock
stealthrock.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25x, 0.5x, neutral, 2x, or 4x, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
stealthrock.shortDesc: Hurts foes on switch-in. Factors Rock weakness.

steameruption.name: Steam Eruption
steameruption.desc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.
steameruption.shortDesc: 30% chance to burn the target. Thaws target.

steamroller.name: Steamroller
steamroller.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
steamroller.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

steelbeam.name: Steel Beam
steelbeam.desc: Whether or not this move is successful and even if it would cause fainting, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, unless the user has the Magic Guard Ability.

steelroller.name: Steel Roller
steelroller.desc: Fails if there is no terrain or if the field lasts more than 10 turns. After a successful hit, ends Core terrain and temporary Z/ability fields. Permanent fields remain.
steelroller.shortDesc: Clears Core and temporary Z/ability fields; fails on long fields.

steelwing.name: Steel Wing
steelwing.desc: Has a 30% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.
steelwing.shortDesc: 30% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.

steelystrike.name: Steely Strike
steelystrike.desc: Ignores and removes Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, and Arenite Wall from the target's side. 1.5x power in Fairy Tale Field.
steelystrike.shortDesc: Removes screens and Arenite Wall; 1.5x in Fairy Tale.

stickyweb.name: Sticky Web
stickyweb.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, lowering the Speed by 1 stage of each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
stickyweb.shortDesc: Lowers Speed of grounded foes by 1 on switch-in.

stockpile.name: Stockpile
stockpile.desc: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage and adds 1 Stockpile count, up to 3. At the end of each turn, the user heals 1/32 max HP for each Stockpile count. The count resets when the user leaves the field.
stockpile.shortDesc: +1 Def/SpD and Stockpile. Heals 1/32 per stack each turn. Max 3.

stomp.name: Stomp
stomp.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
stomp.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

stompingtantrum.name: Stomping Tantrum
stompingtantrum.desc: Power doubles if the user's last move on the previous turn, including moves called by other moves or those used through Instruct, Magic Coat, Snatch, or the Dancer or Magic Bounce Abilities, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, or Mind Blown, or if the user was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging or Sky Drop. A move that was blocked by Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.
stompingtantrum.shortDesc: Power doubles if the user's last move failed.

stoneaxe.name: Stone Axe
stoneaxe.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. If this move hits, it sets Stealth Rock on the opposing side.
stoneaxe.shortDesc: High critical-hit ratio; sets Stealth Rock on the opposing side.

stoneedge.name: Stone Edge
stoneedge.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

storedpower.name: Stored Power
storedpower.desc: Power is equal to 20+(X*20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.
storedpower.shortDesc: + 20 power for each of the user's stat boosts.

stormthrow.name: Storm Throw
stormthrow.desc: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.
stormthrow.shortDesc: Always results in a critical hit.

strangesteam.name: Strange Steam
strangesteam.desc: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

strength.name: Strength
strength.desc: This Fighting-type move ignores the target's Defense boosts and cannot be weakened by Reflect, Aurora Veil, or Arenite Wall.
strength.shortDesc: Ignores Def boosts, Reflect, Veil, Arenite Wall.

strengthsap.name: Strength Sap
strengthsap.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage. The user restores its HP equal to the target's Attack stat calculated with its stat stage before this move was used. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. Fails if the target's Attack stat stage is -6.
strengthsap.shortDesc: User heals HP=target's Atk stat. Lowers Atk by 1.

stringshot.name: String Shot
stringshot.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

struggle.name: Struggle
struggle.desc: Deals typeless damage to a random opposing Pokemon. If this move was successful, the user loses 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up, and the Rock Head Ability does not prevent this. This move is automatically used if none of the user's known moves can be selected.
struggle.shortDesc: User loses 1/4 of its max HP.

strugglebug.name: Struggle Bug
strugglebug.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
strugglebug.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Sp. Atk by 1.

stuffcheeks.name: Stuff Cheeks
stuffcheeks.desc: This move cannot be selected unless the user is holding a Berry. The user eats its Berry and raises its Defense by 2 stages. This effect is not prevented by the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room. Fails if the user is not holding a Berry.
stuffcheeks.shortDesc: Must hold Berry to use. User eats Berry, Def +2.

submission.name: Submission
submission.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.desc: The user takes 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, and puts it into a substitute to take its place in battle. The substitute is removed once enough damage is inflicted on it, if the user switches out or faints, or if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up. Baton Pass can be used to transfer the substitute to an ally, and the substitute will keep its remaining HP. Until the substitute is broken, it receives damage from all attacks made by other Pokemon and shields the user from status effects and stat stage changes caused by other Pokemon. Sound-based moves and Pokemon with the Infiltrator Ability ignore substitutes. The user still takes normal damage from weather and status effects while behind its substitute. If the substitute breaks during a multi-hit attack, the user will take damage from any remaining hits. If a substitute is created while the user is trapped by a binding move, the binding effect ends immediately. Fails if the user does not have enough HP remaining to create a substitute without fainting, or if it already has a substitute. Pulse and Rift forms cannot create or retain a substitute; transforming into these forms or receiving a transferred substitute breaks it.
substitute.shortDesc: User takes 1/4 its max HP to put in a substitute.

suckerpunch.name: Sucker Punch
suckerpunch.desc: Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.
suckerpunch.shortDesc: Usually goes first. Fails if target is not attacking.

sunnyday.name: Sunny Day
sunnyday.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sunny Day. The damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Heat Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sunny Day.
sunnyday.shortDesc: For 5 turns, intense sunlight powers Fire moves.

sunsteelstrike.name: Sunsteel Strike
sunsteelstrike.desc: This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
sunsteelstrike.shortDesc: Ignores the Abilities of other Pokemon.

supercellslam.name: Supercell Slam
supercellslam.desc: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
supercellslam.shortDesc: User is hurt by 50% of its max HP if it misses.

superfang.name: Super Fang
superfang.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.
superfang.shortDesc: Does damage equal to 1/2 target's current HP.

superpower.name: Superpower
superpower.desc: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
superpower.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1.

supersonic.name: Supersonic
supersonic.desc: Causes the target to become confused.
supersonic.shortDesc: Causes the target to become confused.

surf.name: Surf
surf.desc: Damage doubles if the target is using Dive.
surf.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dive.

surgingstrikes.name: Surging Strikes
surgingstrikes.desc: Hits three times. This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.
surgingstrikes.shortDesc: Always results in a critical hit. Hits 3 times.

swagger.name: Swagger
swagger.desc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and confuses it.
swagger.shortDesc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 and confuses it.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.desc: The user spends its Stockpile count to heal: 1 stack heals 1/4 max HP, 2 stacks heal 1/2, and 3 stacks fully heal and cure the user's status. Fails at 0 stacks. The user's Stockpile Defense and Special Defense boosts are removed, and the count resets to 0.
swallow.shortDesc: Spends Stockpile to heal; at 3 fully heals and cures status.

sweetkiss.name: Sweet Kiss
sweetkiss.desc: Causes the target to become confused.
sweetkiss.shortDesc: Causes the target to become confused.

sweetscent.name: Sweet Scent
sweetscent.desc: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 2 stages.

swift.name: Swift
swift.desc: This move does not check accuracy.
swift.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy. Hits foes.

switcheroo.name: Switcheroo
switcheroo.desc: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if either the user or the target is holding a Mail or Z-Crystal, if neither is holding an item, if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, a Red Orb, a Griseous Orb, a Plate, a Drive, or a Memory to or from a Kyogre, a Groudon, a Giratina, an Arceus, a Genesect, or a Silvally, respectively. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.
switcheroo.shortDesc: User switches its held item with the target's.

swordsdance.name: Swords Dance
swordsdance.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 2 stages.

synchronoise.name: Synchronoise
synchronoise.desc: The target is immune if it does not share a type with the user.
synchronoise.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon sharing the user's type.

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Delta Stream or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.
synthesis.shortDesc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

syrupbomb.name: Syrup Bomb
syrupbomb.desc: If this move is successful, it causes the target's Speed to be lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn for 3 turns.
syrupbomb.shortDesc: Target's Speed is lowered by 1 stage for 3 turns.

tachyoncutter.name: Tachyon Cutter
tachyoncutter.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. This move does not check accuracy.
tachyoncutter.shortDesc: Hits twice. This move does not check accuracy.

tailglow.name: Tail Glow
tailglow.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack by 3 stages.
tailglow.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 3.

tailslap.name: Tail Slap
tailslap.desc: Hits two to five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 5-6 times.

tailwhip.name: Tail Whip
tailwhip.desc: Lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.desc: For 4 turns, the user and its party members have their Speed doubled. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
tailwind.shortDesc: For 4 turns, allies' Speed is doubled.

takedown.name: Take Down
takedown.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

takeheart.name: Take Heart
takeheart.desc: The user cures its non-volatile status condition. Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.
takeheart.shortDesc: Cures user's status, raises Sp. Atk, Sp. Def by 1.

tarshot.name: Tar Shot
tarshot.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage. Until the target switches out, the effectiveness of Fire-type moves is doubled against it.
tarshot.shortDesc: Target gets -1 Spe and becomes weaker to Fire.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.
taunt.shortDesc: Target can't use status moves its next 3 turns.

tearfullook.name: Tearful Look
tearfullook.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
tearfullook.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.

teatime.name: Teatime
teatime.desc: All active Pokemon consume their held Berries. This effect is not prevented by substitutes, the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a Berry.
teatime.shortDesc: All active Pokemon consume held Berries.

technoblast.name: Techno Blast
technoblast.desc: This move's type depends on the user's held Drive.
technoblast.shortDesc: Type varies based on the held Drive.

tectonicrage.name: Tectonic Rage
tectonicrage.desc: A one-use Ground-type Z-Move. Its power depends on the damaging Ground-type move selected as its base.
tectonicrage.shortDesc: Power depends on the base Ground-type move.

teeterdance.name: Teeter Dance
teeterdance.desc: Causes the target to become confused.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.desc: For 3 turns, the target cannot avoid any attacks made against it, other than OHKO moves, as long as it remains active. During the effect, the target is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will gain the effect. Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball override this move if the target is under any of their effects. Fails if the target is already under this effect or the effects of Ingrain, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows. The target is immune to this move on use if its species is Diglett, Dugtrio, Alolan Diglett, Alolan Dugtrio, Sandygast, Palossand, or Gengar while Mega-Evolved. Mega Gengar cannot be under this effect by any means.
telekinesis.shortDesc: For 3 turns, target floats but moves can't miss it.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.

temperflare.name: Temper Flare
temperflare.desc: Power doubles if the user's last move on the previous turn, including moves called by other moves or those used through Instruct, Magic Coat, Snatch, or the Dancer or Magic Bounce Abilities, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, or Mind Blown, or if the user was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging or Sky Drop. A move that was blocked by Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.
temperflare.shortDesc: Power doubles if the user's last move failed.

terablast.name: Tera Blast
terablast.desc: If the user is Terastallized, this move becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes, and this move's type becomes the same as the user's Tera Type. In addition, if the user's Tera Type is Stellar, this move has 100 power, is super effective against Terastallized targets and neutral against other targets, and lowers the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
terablast.shortDesc: If Terastallized: Phys. if Atk > SpA, type = Tera.

terastarstorm.name: Tera Starstorm
terastarstorm.desc: If the user is a Terapagos in Stellar Form, this move's type becomes Stellar, hits all opposing Pokemon, and becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes.
terastarstorm.shortDesc: Terapagos-Stellar: Stellar type, hits both foes.

terrainpulse.name: Terrain Pulse
terrainpulse.desc: Power doubles if the user is grounded and a terrain is active, and this move's type changes to match. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain.
terrainpulse.shortDesc: User on terrain: power doubles, type varies.

thief.name: Thief
thief.desc: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mail or Z-Crystal, or if the target is a Kyogre holding a Blue Orb, a Groudon holding a Red Orb, a Giratina holding a Griseous Orb, an Arceus holding a Plate, a Genesect holding a Drive, a Silvally holding a Memory, or a Pokemon that can Mega Evolve holding the Mega Stone for its species. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
thief.shortDesc: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.

thousandarrows.name: Thousand Arrows
thousandarrows.desc: This move can hit airborne Pokemon, which includes Flying-type Pokemon, Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, Pokemon holding an Air Balloon, and Pokemon under the effect of Magnet Rise or Telekinesis. If the target is a Flying type and is not already grounded, this move deals neutral damage regardless of its other type(s). This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. During the effect, Magnet Rise fails for the target and Telekinesis fails against the target.
thousandarrows.shortDesc: Grounds adjacent foes. First hit neutral on Flying.

thousandwaves.name: Thousand Waves
thousandwaves.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
thousandwaves.shortDesc: Hits adjacent foes. Prevents them from switching.

thrash.name: Thrash
thrash.desc: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
thrash.shortDesc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

throatchop.name: Throat Chop
throatchop.desc: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves.
throatchop.shortDesc: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound moves.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.
thunder.shortDesc: 30% chance to paralyze. Can't miss in rain.

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
thunderbolt.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

thundercage.name: Thunder Cage
thundercage.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
thundercage.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.desc: Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.
thunderclap.shortDesc: Usually goes first. Fails if target is not attacking.

thunderfang.name: Thunder Fang
thunderfang.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
thunderfang.shortDesc: 10% chance to paralyze. 10% chance to flinch.

thunderouskick.name: Thunderous Kick
thunderouskick.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
thunderouskick.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

thunderpunch.name: Thunder Punch
thunderpunch.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

thundershock.name: Thunder Shock
thundershock.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

thunderwave.name: Thunder Wave
thunderwave.desc: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.

tickle.name: Tickle
tickle.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
tickle.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1.

tidyup.name: Tidy Up
tidyup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage. Removes substitutes from all active Pokemon and ends the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes for both sides.
tidyup.shortDesc: User +1 Atk, Spe. Clears all substitutes/hazards.

topsyturvy.name: Topsy-Turvy
topsyturvy.desc: The target's positive stat stages become negative and vice versa. Fails if all of the target's stat stages are 0.

torchsong.name: Torch Song
torchsong.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
torchsong.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.

torment.name: Torment
torment.desc: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.
torment.shortDesc: Target can't select the same move twice in a row.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.desc: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.
toxic.shortDesc: Badly poisons the target. Poison types can't miss.

toxicspikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxicspikes.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, but a substitute does not.
toxicspikes.shortDesc: Poisons grounded foes on switch-in. Max 2 layers.

toxicthread.name: Toxic Thread
toxicthread.desc: Poisons all adjacent foes and lowers their Speed by 2 stages.
toxicthread.shortDesc: Poisons all adjacent foes and lowers their Speed by 2.

trailblaze.name: Trailblaze
trailblaze.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
trailblaze.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.

transform.name: Transform
transform.desc: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.
transform.shortDesc: Copies target's stats, moves, types, and Ability.

triattack.name: Tri Attack
triattack.desc: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target. In Free-for-All battles, this move hits all adjacent foes at full power.
triattack.shortDesc: 20% status. FFA: hits all adjacent foes at full power.

trick.name: Trick
trick.desc: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if either the user or the target is holding a Mail or Z-Crystal, if neither is holding an item, if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, a Red Orb, a Griseous Orb, a Plate, a Drive, or a Memory to or from a Kyogre, a Groudon, a Giratina, an Arceus, a Genesect, or a Silvally, respectively. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.
trick.shortDesc: User switches its held item with the target's.

trickortreat.name: Trick-or-Treat
trickortreat.desc: Causes the Ghost type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Ghost type. If Forest's Curse adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.
trickortreat.shortDesc: Adds Ghost to the target's type(s).

trickroom.name: Trick Room
trickroom.desc: For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
trickroom.shortDesc: Goes last. For 5 turns, turn order is reversed.

triplearrows.name: Triple Arrows
triplearrows.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage, a 30% chance to make it flinch, and a higher chance for a critical hit.

tripleaxel.name: Triple Axel
tripleaxel.desc: Hits three times. Power increases to 40 for the second hit and 60 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.
tripleaxel.shortDesc: Hits 3 times. Each hit can miss, but power rises.

triplekick.name: Triple Kick
triplekick.desc: Hits up to three times with 20, 40, then 60 Base Power. Each hit checks accuracy, and the attack ends if a hit misses. If the user has Skill Link, this move always hits three times.
triplekick.shortDesc: Hits up to 3 times: 20/40/60 BP. Each hit can miss.

tropkick.name: Trop Kick
tropkick.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
tropkick.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

trumpcard.name: Trump Card
trumpcard.desc: The power of this move is based on the amount of PP remaining after normal PP reduction and the Pressure Ability resolve. 200 power for 0 PP, 80 power for 1 PP, 60 power for 2 PP, 50 power for 3 PP, and 40 power for 4 or more PP.
trumpcard.shortDesc: More power the fewer PP this move has left.

twinbeam.name: Twin Beam
twinbeam.desc: Hits twice, with 60 power per hit. The second hit can damage the target after the first breaks its substitute.
twinbeam.shortDesc: Hits twice, with 60 power per hit.

twineedle.name: Twineedle
twineedle.desc: Hits one target twice. Each hit has a 20% chance to poison the target and a high critical-hit ratio.
twineedle.shortDesc: Hits twice; high critical-hit ratio; 20% poison per hit.

twirlytwister.name: Twirly Twister
twirlytwister.desc: After a successful hit, removes entry hazards from both sides and all active Substitutes.
twirlytwister.shortDesc: After hitting, clears hazards and active Substitutes.

twister.name: Twister
twister.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Power doubles if the target is using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop.
twister.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.

upperhand.name: Upper Hand
upperhand.desc: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the target did not select a priority move for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.
upperhand.shortDesc: 100% flinch. Fails unless target using priority.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.desc: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. On the first of the three turns, all sleeping active Pokemon wake up. During the three turns, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon switched in during the effect do not wake up. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.
uproar.shortDesc: Lasts 3 turns. Active Pokemon cannot fall asleep.

uturn.name: U-turn
uturn.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
uturn.shortDesc: User switches out after damaging the target.

vcreate.name: V-create
vcreate.desc: Lowers the user's Speed, Defense, and Special Defense by 1 stage.
vcreate.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Defense, Sp. Def, Speed by 1.

veeveevolley.name: Veevee Volley
veeveevolley.desc: Power is equal to the greater of (user's Happiness * 2/5), rounded down, or 1. Uses the user's higher offensive stat.
veeveevolley.shortDesc: Max happiness: 102 power; uses higher Atk or SpA; can't miss.

venomdrench.name: Venom Drench
venomdrench.desc: Lowers the target's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 1 stage if the target is poisoned. Fails if the target is not poisoned.
venomdrench.shortDesc: Lowers Atk/Sp. Atk/Speed of poisoned foes by 1.

venoshock.name: Venoshock
venoshock.desc: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.
venoshock.shortDesc: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.

victorydance.name: Victory Dance
victorydance.desc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
victorydance.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Speed by 1.

vileassault.name: Vile Assault
vileassault.desc: Attacks a target attempting to switch out before it leaves, without doubling this move's 90 power. It cannot miss a switching target. When the target does not switch, this move attacks normally.
vileassault.shortDesc: 90 power; hits a switching target before it leaves and cannot miss it.

vitalthrow.name: Vital Throw
vitalthrow.desc: This move does not check accuracy.
vitalthrow.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy. Goes last.

voltswitch.name: Volt Switch
voltswitch.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
voltswitch.shortDesc: User switches out after damaging the target.

volttackle.name: Volt Tackle
volttackle.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
volttackle.shortDesc: Has 33% recoil. 10% chance to paralyze target.

wakeupshock.name: Wake-Up Shock
wakeupshock.desc: This move has 160 power against a sleeping target and cures its sleep after a successful hit. Against an awake target, it has 80 power and a 30% chance to paralyze it.
wakeupshock.shortDesc: 160 power and wakes sleeping targets; otherwise 30% paralysis chance.

wakeupslap.name: Wake-Up Slap
wakeupslap.desc: Power doubles if the target is asleep. If the user has not fainted, the target wakes up.
wakeupslap.shortDesc: Power doubles if target is asleep, and wakes it.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
waterfall.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

waterpledge.name: Water Pledge
waterpledge.desc: If one of the user's allies chose to use Fire Pledge or Grass Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Fire Pledge, the ally uses Water Pledge with 150 power and a rainbow appears on the user's side for 4 turns, which doubles secondary effect chances and stacks with the Serene Grace Ability, except effects that cause flinching can only have their chance doubled once. If combined with Grass Pledge, the ally uses Grass Pledge with 150 power and a swamp appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which quarters the Speed of each Pokemon on that side. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Water Gem, and cannot be redirected by the Storm Drain Ability.
waterpledge.shortDesc: Use with Grass or Fire Pledge for added effect.

waterpulse.name: Water Pulse
waterpulse.desc: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

watershuriken.name: Water Shuriken
watershuriken.desc: This 20 Base Power move has +1 priority, an increased critical-hit ratio, and hits two to six times. With Shadow Current, it always critically hits: the first hit has 90 Base Power, followed by one to four 20 Base Power hits, or two to five follow-up hits in Free-For-All. Ash-Greninja with Shadow Bond uses 30 Base Power, hits exactly three times, and always critically hits.
watershuriken.shortDesc: +1 priority. 20 BP, high crit, hits 2-6. Greninja forms have special patterns.

watersport.name: Water Sport
watersport.desc: For 5 turns, all Fire-type attacks used by any active Pokemon have their power multiplied by 0.33. Fails if this effect is already active.
watersport.shortDesc: For 5 turns, Fire-type attacks have 1/3 power.

waterspout.name: Water Spout
waterspout.desc: Power is equal to (user's current HP * 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.
waterspout.shortDesc: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).

wavecrash.name: Wave Crash
wavecrash.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

weatherball.name: Weather Ball
weatherball.desc: Power doubles if a weather condition other than Delta Stream is active, and this move's type changes to match. Ice type during Snow, Water type during Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, Rock type during Sandstorm, and Fire type during Desolate Land or Sunny Day. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and uses Weather Ball during Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Desolate Land, or Sunny Day, this move remains Normal type and does not double in power.
weatherball.shortDesc: Power doubles and type varies in each weather.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
whirlpool.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.
whirlwind.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

wickedblow.name: Wicked Blow
wickedblow.desc: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.
wickedblow.shortDesc: Always results in a critical hit.

wickedtorque.name: Wicked Torque
wickedtorque.desc: Has a 10% chance to cause the target to fall asleep.
wickedtorque.shortDesc: 10% chance to cause the target to fall asleep.

wideguard.name: Wide Guard
wideguard.desc: The user and its party members are protected from moves made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn that target all adjacent foes or all adjacent Pokemon. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
wideguard.shortDesc: Protects allies from multi-target moves this turn.

wildboltstorm.name: Wildbolt Storm
wildboltstorm.desc: Has a 20% chance to paralyze the target. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, or if Electric Terrain is active, this move does not check accuracy. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 80%.
wildboltstorm.shortDesc: 20% chance to paralyze foe(s). Rain/Electric Terrain: can't miss.

wildcharge.name: Wild Charge
wildcharge.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

willowisp.name: Will-O-Wisp
willowisp.desc: Burns the target. This move does not check accuracy if used by a Ghost-type Pokemon.
willowisp.shortDesc: Burns the target. Ghost users never miss.

wish.name: Wish
wish.desc: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of the user's maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.
wish.shortDesc: Next turn, 50% of the user's max HP is restored.

withdraw.name: Withdraw
withdraw.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.

wonderroom.name: Wonder Room
wonderroom.desc: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon have their Defense and Special Defense stats swapped. Stat stage changes are unaffected. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
wonderroom.shortDesc: For 5 turns, all Defense and Sp. Def stats switch.

woodhammer.name: Wood Hammer
woodhammer.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

workup.name: Work Up
workup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
workup.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.

worryseed.name: Worry Seed
worryseed.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become Insomnia. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Insomnia, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
wrap.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

wringout.name: Wring Out
wringout.desc: Power is equal to 120 * (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.
wringout.shortDesc: More power the more HP the target has left.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.
yawn.shortDesc: Puts the target to sleep after 1 turn.

zapcannon.name: Zap Cannon
zapcannon.desc: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.

zenheadbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
zenheadbutt.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
zenheadbutt.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

zingzap.name: Zing Zap
zingzap.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
zingzap.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

zippyzap.name: Zippy Zap
zippyzap.desc: Usually moves before other attacks. This move will always result in a critical hit.

anomalycore.name: Anomaly Core
anomalycore.desc: Allows designated Pokemon to undergo Pulse/Rift Evolution. Pulse and Rift forms cannot have a Substitute; existing or transferred substitutes break. Camerupt must be at full HP immediately before Pulse Evolution or it faints.
anomalycore.shortDesc: Pulse/Rift Evolution; no Substitute. Camerupt must be at full HP or faints.

choiceband.name: Choice Band
choiceband.desc: Holder's Attack is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.
choiceband.shortDesc: Holder's Attack is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

choicescarf.name: Choice Scarf
choicescarf.desc: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.
choicescarf.shortDesc: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

choicespecs.name: Choice Specs
choicespecs.desc: Holder's Sp. Atk is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.
choicespecs.shortDesc: Holder's Sp. Atk is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

eeviumz.name: Eevium Z
eeviumz.desc: Eevee forms: 1.5x Def/SpD, heals 1/16 HP/turn; Extreme Evoboost via Last Resort or Veevee Volley.
eeviumz.shortDesc: Eevee forms: 1.5x Def/SpD, heals 1/16 HP/turn; Extreme Evoboost via Last Resort or Veevee Volley.

metronome.name: Metronome
metronome.desc: Damage of moves used on consecutive turns is increased. Max 2x after 5 turns.
metronome.shortDesc: Damage of moves used on consecutive turns is increased. Max 2x after 5 turns.

pokeball.name: Poke Ball
pokeball.desc: A device for catching wild Pokemon. It is designed as a capsule system.
pokeball.shortDesc: A device for catching wild Pokemon. It is designed as a capsule system.

prismscale.name: Prism Scale
prismscale.desc: Evolves Feebas into Milotic when traded.
prismscale.shortDesc: Evolves Feebas into Milotic when traded.
